description: copy.top's read of one major hyperliquid market (btc, eth, sol, hype, xrp and a few more; not xyz: markets): technicals (rsi, emas, trend), funding vs its history and other venues, premium, open interest changes, what the top 300 traders hold and their latest moves, nearby liquidations, fear and greed. funding.state is neutral when hourly funding is within 10% of the base rate (0.00125% an hour), above_base over it, below_base under it; funding.payer says who pays this hour (longs when funding is positive, shorts when negative), so below_base can still mean longs pay.
name: hl_get_market_read
title: hyperliquid market read
